subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the Control UI/Gateway structured reply-metadata umbrella while final-fallback work stays in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, or should maintainers split and close it behind narrower canonical items now?
rationale: Current source proves real remaining work, but the permanent boundary crosses public Gateway schema, Control UI UX, runtime metadata, and final fallback delivery semantics, and an open conflicting PR already covers only part of the reply-metadata shape.

options.title: Keep As Coordination Umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the Control UI/Gateway reply metadata contract and explicitly route the no-output half to the final-fallback contract.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Create or designate a narrower Control UI/Gateway reply metadata tracker, rely on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final fallback, then close this combined issue as superseded.

options.title: Treat Quote Text As Sufficient
options.body: Declare the current Markdown quote behavior sufficient for Control UI and keep only final-fallback delivery work active.

recommendation.title: Keep As Coordination Umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the Control UI/Gateway reply metadata contract and explicitly route the no-output half to the final-fallback contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and prior review routing both point to this person for the Control UI send path, Gateway schema, and runtime-context coordination surface.
